An '''Appointed Intermediate''' was a title for a being that represented the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] region in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Dorosii]] the Hutt was the Appointed Intermediate of the Periphery region.
